object: Customers must initiate a return within 30 days of delivery to receive a full refund.
subject: 1. General Return Window

object: Items returned between day 31 and day 45 must be processed as store credit only.
subject: 1. General Return Window

object: Items returned after day 45 must not receive any refund or credit.
subject: 1. General Return Window

object: Returned items must be unused, in their original packaging, and must include all accessories and manuals.
subject: 2. Condition Requirements

object: Staff must apply a 15% restocking fee to items missing original packaging.
subject: 2. Condition Requirements

object: Items showing signs of use must not be accepted for return under this policy.
subject: 2. Condition Requirements

object: Electronics must be returned within 14 days of delivery, regardless of the general return window described in Section 1.
subject: 3. Electronics Exceptions

object: Opened software and digital license keys must be treated as final sale and must not be accepted for return under any circumstances.
subject: 3. Electronics Exceptions

object: Clearance items marked "Final Sale" at checkout must not be accepted for return or exchange.
subject: 4. Final Sale Items

object: Custom or personalized items must be treated as final sale once production has begun.
subject: 4. Final Sale Items

object: Customers must report damaged or defective items within 48 hours of delivery to qualify for a free replacement or full refund including return shipping costs.
subject: 5. Damaged or Defective Items

object: Reports made after 48 hours must be handled under the general return window described in Section 1, with return shipping paid by the customer.
subject: 5. Damaged or Defective Items

object: Staff must issue approved refunds to the original payment method within 5-7 business days of the returned item being received and inspected.
subject: 6. Refund Processing

object: Store credit issued under Section 1 must not expire and may be combined with future promotional discounts.
subject: 6. Refund Processing

object: Staff must waive the restocking fee described in Section 2 for exchanges of the same item in a different size or color, provided the request is made within the general return window described in Section 1.
subject: 7. Exchanges

object: Exchanges for a different product entirely must be processed as a return followed by a new purchase.
subject: 7. Exchanges

object: Returns requested outside any window described above must receive manager approval before processing.
subject: 8. Escalation and Manager Approval

object: Staff must record manager-approved exceptions in the order notes before a refund or credit is issued.
subject: 8. Escalation and Manager Approval
